programmes.pitch: A Maths teacher who knows your child's name, every Thursday, until the final exam.
programmes.lede: Every Thursday evening, your Grade 12 learner joins a live, two-hour Mathematics class online, in a group of no more than 10. From February until the NSC exam, the work follows the Grade 12 CAPS syllabus, with the heaviest-weighted exam topics getting the most time.

faq: Which topics are covered?
The full Grade 12 CAPS Mathematics syllabus. Topics are sequenced by DBE mark weighting, so the sections worth the most marks are taught first and revised most.
What if my child misses a session?
The recording and the homework pack are shared with them. We don't refund missed sessions.
When does the programme end?
Thursday classes run until the NSC exam. We confirm the last date once the DBE publishes the 2027 NSC timetable.
Is there extra exam help?
Yes. The Exam Bootcamp runs in the June and September/October school holidays, and Grade 12 learners can join it.

blocks.name: Paper 1 block
blocks.text: Algebra, functions, calculus, finance and probability, heaviest-weighted topics first.

blocks.name: Paper 2 block
blocks.text: Geometry, trigonometry and statistics, taught after Paper 1 so nothing is revised before it has been taught.

blocks.name: Combined revision
blocks.text: Mixed, timed past-paper practice. Paper 2 is revised before Paper 1, so Paper 1 is freshest when its exam arrives.

faq: Is this the free government Second Chance programme?
No. GeniusEdge's Second Chances Programme is a private, paid programme. It is separate from the free Second Chance Matric Programme run by the Department of Basic Education.
Which intake should I choose?

Intake A (February to May) finishes before the May/June exam sitting. Intake B (July to October) prepares you for the end-of-year exams. If you're unsure, message us on WhatsApp with your last Maths mark and we'll suggest one.
How is it billed?
Four monthly payments per intake, on the 1st of each month. Intake A is four payments, and so is Intake B.
Can I join an intake after it has started?
Message us on WhatsApp. Each intake is capped at 10 seats, and we'll tell you whether there is room and how much has been covered.

programmes.name: Grade 10 Weekly
programmes.pitch: Grade 10 decides Grade 12. Fix the foundation now, for R550 a month.
programmes.lede: Every Tuesday evening, your Grade 10 learner joins a live two-hour Mathematics class online, in a group of no more than 10. The class builds the algebra, functions and number skills that Grade 11 and Grade 12 depend on, so gaps get fixed before they get expensive.
programmes.forWho: Grade 10 learners building the foundation for Mathematics in the FET phase.
includes: A live two-hour class every Tuesday, with the recording shared afterwards
Grade 10 CAPS topics in a fixed order, so nothing is skipped
A worked anchor question from a past paper in every session
Marked homework with voice-note feedback within 48 hours
A one-page parent report on the last Friday of each month
faq: Does my child need to be strong at Maths already?
No. The class is built to strengthen the foundation, so learners at any level are welcome as long as they are in Grade 10.
Online or in person?
This class is online. If you'd prefer face-to-face teaching, see the Grade 10 Saturday Class.
What if my child misses a session?
The recording and the homework pack are shared with them. We don't refund missed sessions.
Is Grade 11 covered?
Not currently. Our 2027 programmes are Grade 10, Grade 12 and matric rewrite Mathematics.

faq: Where is the Saturday class held?
At a venue in Johannesburg. We share the venue details with enrolled families before the first class.
Why does the page say "up to 4 sessions" a month?
The class runs in term time only. Months that include school holidays have fewer Saturdays, and some months have five. The sessions table on this page shows the actual count for each month.
What if my child misses a Saturday?
The practice work is shared with them. We don't refund missed sessions.
Can my child join the online class as well?
Ask us on WhatsApp. The topic order is the same, so the two classes fit together.

programmes.pitch: Five days. Every exam topic. Past papers marked like the real thing.
programmes.lede: A five-day online bootcamp in the school holidays before the exams. Three hours a day across every exam topic, with past-paper questions marked the way the real exam is marked. Open to Grade 12 and Second Chances learners. There are two runs in 2027.
programmes.forWho: Grade 12 and Second Chances learners getting ready for their exams.
includes: Five live days of three hours each, across every exam topic
Past-paper questions cited by year and paper, marked like the real exam
Paper 1 and Paper 2 revision, each topic taught under the correct paper
A homework pack for each day
faq: Who can join?
Grade 12 learners and Second Chances learners. It is built for the weeks before the exam, so it works best for learners who have already covered the syllabus.
What does early bird mean?
The early-bird price is R500 and the standard price is R800. Message us on WhatsApp if you're unsure which price applies when you enrol.
Can I get a refund?
Yes, up to 7 days before the bootcamp starts.
Does it replace weekly classes?
No. It is an exam-preparation sprint that adds to the weekly classes, not a substitute.
programmes.metaDescription: Five-day online Mathematics Exam Bootcamp for Grade 12 and matric rewrite learners. Every exam topic, past papers marked like the real thing. From R500.

generalFaq: Grade 10, Grade 12 and matric rewrite learners, in Mathematics only. We don't teach Maths Literacy, and we don't currently teach Grade 11.
No more than 10 learners in each online group, 15 in the Saturday class, and 20 in the bootcamp. That is small enough for every learner to be seen and heard.

Monthly programmes take ten payments in advance on the 1st, January to October, by card subscription, or by Instant EFT or Capitec Pay against a monthly payment link. Second Chances is four payments per intake. Paying a full term up front earns 10% off.
How do I stop monthly billing?
Message us on WhatsApp or email us before the 25th of the month, and the next month's debit will not be taken. There are no partial-month refunds.
Do I pay a card fee?
No. Our prices include card fees, and there is no card surcharge at checkout. Card details are entered only on Paystack's secure checkout, never over WhatsApp or on this website.
When can I enrol and pay?
The waitlist is open now. Paid enrolment opens on 1 December 2026, and the first sessions run in the week of 1 February 2027.
Is Second Chances the free government programme?
No. GeniusEdge's Second Chances Programme is a private, paid programme, separate from the free Second Chance Matric Programme run by the Department of Basic Education.
